payload.scientific_problem: Prepare a small prospective endpoint panel that can later test whether the baseline and expanded compositional structural-subgoal generators produce useful molecules, without using teacher recovery metrics or task scores for selection.

selection_semantics.candidate_order: the original serialized candidate-list order defines one-indexed rank
selection_semantics.within_cell_arm_canonicalization: compute an eligibility decision for every candidate, quotient eligible candidates by canonical non-isomeric molecular SMILES, and retain the representative with minimum rank then canonical SMILES then candidate identity
selection_semantics.selection: select the one retained eligible representative with minimum rank then canonical SMILES then candidate identity
selection_semantics.cross_arm_deduplication: after independent cell-arm selection, merge requests with identical target, canonical molecule, docking seed and evaluator identity while preserving every cell-arm membership

provenance_requirements.candidate_ledger: every candidate from every selected cell/arm with exact source state, exact endpoint state, actions, original rank, candidate identity, recomputed descriptors, eligibility and all exclusion or nonselection reasons
provenance_requirements.membership_lock: exact selected state/action provenance and immutable candidate-lock identity for every selected cell-arm membership
provenance_requirements.request_lock: deduplicated physical request identity with every preserved membership
provenance_requirements.abstention_ledger: all 20 declared cell-arm units, including absent, empty and no-eligible cases
provenance_requirements.software: code revision, selection implementation hash, RDKit and SA implementation identities

environment.numeric_precision: Python float and RDKit double descriptors

authority.later_authorization_required: Explicitly authorize the exact sealed request-lock physical and payload SHA-256 and its exact call ceiling; no retries, replacements or backfill.

payload.interpretation_limit: This prelock establishes only a prospective score-blind candidate selection protocol. A later sealed panel can establish eligibility coverage, and a separately authorized score run can test endpoint utility. Neither establishes teacher recovery, route recovery, autonomous optimization or an IVG comparison.
